Source metadata groups the 18 photos into 17 groups; these are development data, not untouched holdout or verified motif independence. Checked numbers describe reconstruction of a derived cropped mask, not original artwork success.

runtime.scope: Original raw numerical gates remain failed. Every browser source RGB and input tensor is exact. Both newly selected neural crops, their targets and freshly fitted geometry are byte-identical to the native development run. Production fits are shared controls, not independent runtime replications. No new tolerance inferred from these results.

criticalCropFalsePositive.finding: A small subregion of the green/gold bird photograph is mistaken for the overlap. Low error and physical validity against this cropped target do not establish whole-heart success. The keep-every-production-crop policy suppresses neural evaluation. A post-study neural-only crop diagnostic also returns no candidate; changing selection alone has not solved it.

weakRetainedCrop.finding: The angel crop misses the true tip and misregisters the left side. It is already unsupported and fails paper checks. The independent post-study neural proposal visually follows the full overlap; no fit was run and no new success is claimed.

validation.broadApplicationQA: No application changes in this batch. Latest complete application/build/inverse release QA remains docs/inverse/datasets/conni-release-qa.json; it was not rerun for these offline evaluations.

decision.next: Require credible whole-heart coverage before treating a crop as successful; compare neural proposals for weak existing crops. Keep printed-paper material classification and Santa/stacked-heart topology as separate downstream failures. Preserve fixed cohorts and raw failure counts.
